schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names. Excludes institutional landholders and tax-paying professionals.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.official_fact: Registration and eKYC are completely free on pmkisan.gov.in or Common Service Centres (CSC). There is no ₹15,000 monthly allowance.
schemes.benefits: ₹6,000 per year directly credited into bank accounts in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 via DBT.

schemes.eligibility: Bottom 40% vulnerable families identified based on SECC 2011 criteria + all senior citizens aged 70 and above irrespective of income under Ayushman Vaya Vandana.
schemes.ministry: National Health Authority
schemes.official_fact: Ayushman Cards are generated free of cost at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or government hospitals. No upfront insurance premium is collected.
schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.benefits: Cashless and paperless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empanelled public and private hospitals across India.

schemes.eligibility: Traditional artisans in 18 identified trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, cobblers, tailors, sculptors, boat makers).
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.official_fact: Enrolment is free via CSC portals. No cash transfer of ₹5 Lakh exists.
schemes.scheme_name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme for Traditional Artisans and Craftspeople
schemes.benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card + 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend + ₹15,000 e-voucher toolkit incentive + collateral-free enterprise loan up to ₹1 Lakh (tranche 1) and ₹2 Lakh (tranche 2) at concessional 5% interest rate.

schemes.eligibility: Adult woman belonging to poor household without existing LPG connection.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.official_fact: PMUY provides deposit-free LPG connections to women from below poverty line (BPL) households with first refill and hotplate free of cost. The scheme does NOT provide monthly cash deposits.

schemes.eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below 10 years of age. Maximum 2 accounts per family.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts
schemes.official_fact: Opened at any Post Office or commercial bank. Government does NOT offer ₹2 Lakh bonus lottery.
schemes.scheme_name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) - Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
schemes.benefits: Highest sovereign-backed interest rate (8.2% per annum, compounded annually). Triple tax exemption under EEE regime (Section 80C deduction, tax-free interest, tax-free maturity at age 21). Minimum annual deposit only ₹250.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.official_fact: No registration fee is ever charged. Applications are accepted exclusively via scholarships.gov.in. Any WhatsApp forward demanding ₹500 fee is a scam.
schemes.benefits: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees covered + monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year for hostellers and ₹7,000/year for day scholars.

schemes.eligibility: Any citizen holding an Indian Driving License expiring within 1 year or expired within last 1 year (or up to 5 years with re-test).
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
schemes.official_fact: Statutory government fee is ₹200 (plus ₹200 if smart card issued). Third-party brokers charging ₹2,000 are unnecessary.
schemes.benefits: Faceless contactless renewal without RTO visit via Aadhaar eKYC. Medical certificate Form 1A required only if applicant is 40+ years old.

schemes.eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18+ (or 16+ for gearless 50cc).
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
schemes.official_fact: Citizens can obtain Learner's License completely online from home using Aadhaar authentication. Online road safety test is conducted without visiting RTO in participating states.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs / Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre
schemes.official_fact: Report financial cyber fraud immediately on national helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in within the golden hour to freeze defrauded funds. Government officials never ask for OTPs, UPI PINs, or remote screen sharing apps.
schemes.scheme_name: Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting System (1930 Helpline)

schemes.ministry: Unique Identification Authority of India
schemes.official_fact: Citizens are advised to use Masked Aadhaar (showing only last 4 digits) for verification. Biometrics can be locked/unlocked anytime via myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in. UIDAI never sends legal notices on WhatsApp.
schemes.scheme_name: UIDAI Masked Aadhaar & Biometric Lock Facility

schemes.benefits: Tuition fee waiver up to ₹3,500/year + annual maintenance allowance of ₹1,000 for day scholars and ₹7,000 for hostellers.
schemes.eligibility: Students studying in Classes 9 and 10 in government or recognized private schools with family income below ₹1,00,000 per annum.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
schemes.official_fact: Direct Benefit Transfer into student's Aadhaar-linked savings account. Zero registration fees.
schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities and Vulnerable Groups

schemes.benefits: ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first 3 years; ₹20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level.
schemes.eligibility: Students above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 board exams pursuing regular degree courses with family income below ₹4.5 Lakh.
schemes.ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
schemes.official_fact: Official application via NSP portal. Disbursed directly through Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
schemes.scheme_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students

schemes.benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fees, purchase of laptop, books, and software.
schemes.eligibility: Girl students admitted to 1st year of technical degree/diploma courses in AICTE-approved institutions with family income under ₹8 Lakh.
schemes.ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
schemes.official_fact: Maximum two girls per family eligible. Zero fees to apply.
schemes.scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree/Diploma)

schemes.benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance for crop loss due to non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, pests). Maximum farmer premium is only 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.official_fact: Government of India and State Govts subsidize remainder 90%+ of actuarial premium.

schemes.benefits: Short-term credit for crop cultivation up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 4% effective interest rate (7% baseline minus 3% prompt repayment incentive).
schemes.eligibility: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, self-help groups (SHGs), and joint liability groups of farmers.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / RBI
schemes.official_fact: No processing fees for loans up to ₹1.6 Lakh. Collateral-free limit raised to ₹1.6 Lakh.
schemes.scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme with Interest Subvention

schemes.benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy: 25% subsidy in urban areas and 35% in rural areas for special categories (women, SC, ST, OBC, minorities). Maximum project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for services.
schemes.eligibility: Any individual above 18 years, SHGs, and cooperative societies setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing or service sectors.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (KVIC)
schemes.official_fact: Apply 100% online at kviconline.gov.in with zero application fee. No middleman or agent authorized.

schemes.benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan: 1st tranche ₹10,000; 2nd tranche ₹20,000; 3rd tranche ₹50,000 upon timely repayment. 7% annual interest subsidy credited directly to bank account + up to ₹1,200 annual cashback on digital transactions.
schemes.eligibility: All street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020 with vending certificate or recommendation letter from Urban Local Body (ULB).
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.official_fact: No penalty on early repayment. Zero processing fee charged by banks.
schemes.scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

schemes.benefits: Loans up to ₹20 Lakh across 4 categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (₹10 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh).
schemes.eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises needing business loans.
schemes.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.official_fact: Zero collateral required. Processing fees waived for Shishu category loans.

schemes.benefits: Free digital Udyam Certificate, priority sector lending, collateral-free credit under CGTMSE, protection against delayed payments, 50% subsidy on patent/trademark registration, electricity bill concessions.
schemes.eligibility: Any business entity fitting MSME classification based on composite investment and turnover criteria.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.official_fact: Udyam registration is 100% FREE on official portal udyamregistration.gov.in. Private websites charging ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 are unauthorized impostors.
schemes.scheme_name: Udyam Online Registration for Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises

schemes.benefits: ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover payable to nominee upon death of the insured due to any reason.
schemes.eligibility: Individuals aged 18 to 50 years having a bank savings account with auto-debit consent.
schemes.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.official_fact: Annual premium is strictly ₹436/year auto-debited in May. No agent commission or additional fees.
schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

schemes.benefits: ₹2,00,000 cover for accidental death or total permanent disability; ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability.
schemes.eligibility: Individuals aged 18 to 70 years with a bank savings account.
schemes.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.official_fact: Premium is strictly ₹20 per year. Available at all commercial, regional rural, and cooperative banks.

schemes.benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60 until death, followed by lifetime pension to spouse and corpus return to nominee.
schemes.eligibility: All citizens aged 18 to 40 years holding a savings account. (Non-income tax payers).
schemes.ministry: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
schemes.official_fact: Government guaranteed pension with regulated monthly contributions based on age of entry.

schemes.benefits: Interest subsidy up to 4% on home loans up to ₹25 Lakh for EWS/LIG families, providing net interest relief up to ₹1.80 Lakh.
schemes.eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS - income up to ₹3L), Low Income Group (LIG - income up to ₹6L), Middle Income Group (MIG - income up to ₹9L) families not owning a pucca house anywhere in India.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.official_fact: No fee for PMAY application. State urban bodies register beneficiaries online.

schemes.benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas for pucca house construction + 90-95 days of unskilled labor wage under MGNREGS (approx ₹25,000) + ₹12,000 for toilet under SBM-G.
schemes.eligibility: Rural households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses identified via SECC / Awaas+ list.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.official_fact: 100% grant transferred directly to bank account in geo-tagged construction stages. Zero fees.

schemes.benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 directly transferred to bank account for early registration, antenatal check-up, and institutional delivery.
schemes.eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first living child (₹5,000 in 2 installments) and additional ₹6,000 for second child if girl child.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.official_fact: Application is 100% free through Anganwadi Centres or pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

schemes.benefits: Immediate online test and instant downloadable digital Learner's License from home via Aadhaar authentication.
schemes.eligibility: Citizens aged 16+ (for gearless two-wheeler up to 50cc) or 18+ (for light motor vehicles) passing online road safety audio-visual test.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
schemes.official_fact: Government fee is ₹150 for test and ₹50 per vehicle class. Process is completely faceless.

notifications.citizen_rights: No citizen can be denied benefits solely for lack of Aadhaar if they have applied and provide alternate approved identity documents. Banks cannot charge fees for Aadhaar seeding.
notifications.legal_mandate: Section 7 of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016.
notifications.subject: Direct Benefit Transfer Guidelines for Central Sector and Centrally Sponsored Welfare Schemes
notifications.summary: Mandates that all welfare subsidies, scholarships, and DBT payments must be credited directly to the beneficiary's NPCI Aadhaar-mapped bank account. Strictly prohibits cash disbursement by intermediaries.
notifications.title: Mandatory Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Aadhaar Seeding Notification

notifications.citizen_rights: Students can report extortion or demands for registration money directly to the National Anti-Corruption Helpline 1064 or district vigilance officer.
notifications.issuing_ministry: Ministry of Education & Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
notifications.subject: Statutory Zero Application Fee for National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
notifications.summary: Strictly clarifies that registration, verification, and disbursement on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) is completely free of cost. Any school, college, or third-party kiosk charging money for submitting scholarship applications is committing a penal offense.
notifications.title: Prohibition of Processing Fees for Centrally Sponsored National Scholarships

notifications.citizen_rights: Micro enterprises are exempted from submitting prior turnover or prior experience certificates in public procurement tenders. Zero fee for registration.
notifications.issuing_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
notifications.legal_mandate: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 (Section 7)
notifications.subject: Establishment of Udyam Online Paperless Registration System
notifications.summary: Replaced physical EM-II and UAM with completely paperless, self-declaration based Udyam Registration backed by GSTIN and PAN integration with CBDT.
notifications.title: Simplified Self-Declaration Regime for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

notifications.citizen_rights: Citizens harassed by unauthorized Chinese loan apps or illegal recovery agents can file police complaints on cybercrime.gov.in (National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal) or call 1930.
notifications.legal_mandate: Section 45JA and 45L of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
notifications.subject: Guidelines on Digital Lending - Protection of Borrowers
notifications.summary: Mandates that loans can only be disbursed by RBI-regulated entities (Banks/NBFCs). All lending apps must disclose the name of the regulated lender upfront. Prohibits accessing mobile contacts, photos, or media of borrowers.
notifications.title: Advisory on Illegal Digital Lending Apps and Harassment by Fraudulent Loan Entities

municipalLaws.citizen_remedy: Citizens can report overflowing garbage or black spots with geo-tagged photos for mandatory 24-hour clearance under the Swachhata Citizen Charter.
municipalLaws.governing_body: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change & Municipal Corporations
municipalLaws.jurisdiction: All Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) across India
municipalLaws.mandate: Mandatory door-to-door collection of segregated municipal solid waste (Wet, Dry, Domestic Hazardous). Prohibits burning of leaves, garbage, or plastic in public spaces.
municipalLaws.penal_provisions: Fine up to ₹5,000 for open waste burning or littering. Municipal authorities failing to clear overflowing bins within 24 hours are subject to state pollution control penalties.
municipalLaws.title: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016

municipalLaws.citizen_remedy: Vending disputes must be resolved by the Independent Grievance Redressal Committee chaired by a retired Judicial Magistrate within 30 days.
municipalLaws.governing_body: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & Town Vending Committees (TVC)
municipalLaws.jurisdiction: All Statutory Urban Local Bodies in India
municipalLaws.mandate: Protects registered street vendors from arbitrary eviction. Mandates constitution of Town Vending Committees with at least 40% vendor representation. Eviction only after 30-day notice and designated alternate vending zones.
municipalLaws.penal_provisions: Unauthorized seizure of goods by police or municipal squad without proper receipt and inventory is illegal.
municipalLaws.title: The Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014

municipalLaws.compensatory_penalty: Municipal officers failing to redress reported critical civic hazards within SLA deadline are liable to pay compensatory fine of ₹250/day deducted from salary under the RTS Act.
municipalLaws.governing_body: Municipal Corporations & State Right to Public Services Commissions
municipalLaws.jurisdiction: Urban Municipalities (e.g. GHMC, BBMP, BMC, MCD)

sla_matrix.open_drain_manhole: 6 hours for temporary cover, 24 hours for permanent RCC slab
sla_matrix.water_pipe_leak: 12 hours for valve isolation, 24 hours for pipe replacement

municipalLaws.statutory_act: State Right to Public Services Act (RTS)
municipalLaws.title: Statutory Municipal Citizens Charter & Public Grievance SLA Deadlines

municipalLaws.citizen_remedy: Citizens reporting toxic emissions or illegal smoke during high AQI periods trigger mandatory inspection by Zonal Environmental Flying Squads within 12 hours.
municipalLaws.governing_body: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) & State PCBs
municipalLaws.mandate: Enforces mandatory anti-smog guns, green barricading on construction sites >500 sqm, and ban on biomass/garbage burning. Mandates continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Stations (CAAQMS).
municipalLaws.statutory_act: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
municipalLaws.title: Air Pollution Prevention Bylaws & Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP)

factChecks.official_debunk: PIB Fact Check: FAKE NEWS. Under PM-KISAN, eligible landholding farmer families receive strictly ₹6,000 per year in three installments of ₹2,000.

factChecks.claim_text: Aadhaar will be deactivated within 24 hours if mobile number is not verified via WhatsApp link.
factChecks.official_debunk: UIDAI & PIB Fact Check: FRAUD ALERT. UIDAI never sends deactivation threats over WhatsApp or calls requesting OTP.

factChecks.official_debunk: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy: FAKE. Official application on pmsuryaghar.gov.in has no third-party WhatsApp or Telegram processing fee.
